title: Design System: MetroPulse BLR Control Console

workspace-title.purpose: Top-level workspace headings and junction detail drawer titles.

section-title.purpose: Sub-workspace cards including independent Desk subscription panes.

panel-heading.purpose: Compact 12px bold section titles inside console panels and tabs.

body.purpose: Diagnostic explanations, copilot evidence details, and input labels.

telemetry-kpi.purpose: Tabular-numeral live rates, vehicle delays, and byte counters.

telemetry-label.purpose: Wire tuple tags, axis units, trace ruler ticks, and status pills.

shadows.name: leaflet-popup
shadows.purpose: Floating Leaflet map click popups only; all resting cards are flat.

shadows.name: leaflet-tooltip
shadows.purpose: Hover tooltips over Bengaluru junction markers and arterial links.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Hover border and button state shifts; suppressed when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: reduced-motion-guard
motion.purpose: Global animation/transition clamp active under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-emphasis action for applying MPC runbooks, launching benchmarks, or toggling simulation state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); background: var(--accent, #2563eb); color: var(--accent-contrast, #ffffff); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Control Button
components.description: Quiet inset button used in header controls, zone filters, and signal controller pickers.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #262f3f); background: var(--bg-inset, #1b222e); color: var(--text-primary, #edf1f7); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #364257); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Telemetry Select / Input
components.description: Compact bounded field or picker that avoids mobile 390px horizontal expansion.
components.css: .ds-select { max-width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #262f3f); background: var(--bg-inset, #1b222e); color: var(--text-primary, #edf1f7); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-select:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #364257); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workspace Tab Navigation
components.description: Four-workspace top navigation tablist with keyboard arrow support and clear active hairline underline.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" role="tablist" aria-label="Workspaces"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active" role="tab" aria-selected="true">Network</button><button class="ds-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Junction</button><button class="ds-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Desks</button><button class="ds-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Engineering</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 52px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--bg-surface, #141922); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #262f3f); } .ds-tab { position: relative; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #b4c0d1); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #edf1f7); background: var(--bg-inset, #1b222e); } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--text-primary, #edf1f7); background: var(--accent-tint, rgba(59,130,246,0.14)); border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Semantic Status Pill
components.description: Dual-encoded traffic health chip pairing color state with glyph shape and explicit state word.
components.html: Flow
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); color: var(--state-flow, #10b981); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Console Surface Panel
components.description: Flat 1px hairline-bordered container for KPI groups, counterfactual charts, and benchmark reports.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #262f3f); background: var(--bg-surface, #141922); color: var(--text-primary, #edf1f7); } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary, #edf1f7); } .ds-panel-metric { margin-top: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--state-flow, #10b981); }

components.name: Junction Signal Glyph Tile
components.description: Inset telemetry tile pairing an SVG phase ring glyph with monospace throughput and queue figures.
components.html:
Silk Board
MaxPressure · 11/12 rollouts
components.css: .ds-glyph-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #262f3f); background: var(--bg-inset, #1b222e); } .ds-glyph-name { font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary, #edf1f7); } .ds-glyph-meta { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted, #8a98ad); }

narrative.overview:
MetroPulse BLR is designed as a dense, quiet transport operations console and engineering telemetry instrument rather than a neon cyberpunk dashboard or marketing visualization. Every panel separates cleanly on a dark matte charcoal ground (with full light-theme parity for daylight control rooms) using 1px hairline borders, crisp sentence-case headings, and tabular monospace telemetry aligned for rapid scanning across twelve Bengaluru junctions.

Hierarchy comes from spatial grouping, disciplined weight steps, and restrained semantic state indicators rather than blur glass, gradient fills, drop shadows, or oversized vanity metrics. Visual direction choices and domain terminology (MetroPulse BLR, four-workspace segmentation, and physics/counterfactual framing) were synthesized directly from PRODUCT.md, T08-ui-redesign.md, and the codebase in an unattended session without an interactive interview step.
keyCharacteristics: Dark charcoal control-room ground paired with high-contrast daylight paper parity via semantic CSS custom properties.
One functional cobalt interactive accent (accent-action / accent-ink-*) strictly reserved for selection, active workspaces, focus outlines, and direct operator controls.
Dual-coded traffic health semantics (state-flow, state-heavy, state-gridlock, state-emergency) paired with text labels and SVG glyphs so color is never the sole carrier of meaning.
Strict empirical restraint: persistent Simulated (physics model) context, discrete look-ahead rollout fractions (improvedRollouts/K), and zero decorative numerals.

rules.name: The Functional Chroma Rule
rules.body: Never apply saturated color fills to entire workspace backgrounds or card bodies; chromatic signal stays confined to thin strokes, status pills, map glyphs, and active controls.

rules.name: The Dual-Signal State Rule
rules.body: Every traffic severity color (state-flow, state-heavy, state-gridlock, state-emergency) must be accompanied by an explicit status word, glyph shape, or stroke dash pattern so color-blind operators perceive state identically.

rules.name: The Tabular Lock Rule
rules.body: All updating telemetry values, clock timestamps, countdown timers, byte sizes, and benchmark tables must use .tabular-nums (JetBrains Mono) so streaming updates never shift column widths.

rules.name: The Quiet Scale Rule
rules.body: Keep interface chrome compact (workspace-title maxes at 1rem); establish hierarchy through weight, surface inset, and alignment instead of oversized marketing headers.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting cards, drawers, tables, and navigation bars carry zero box-shadow; structural separation comes solely from .console-panel and .console-inset 1px borders and surface luminance steps.

dos: Do enforce .tabular-nums (JetBrains Mono) on every dynamically updating rate, byte size, countdown, and latency percentile.

Do label simulation provenance (Simulated (physics model)), paired baseline attribution (vs Webster-tuned fixed-time plan, same simulated arrivals), and discrete K-rollout confidence ratios (improvedRollouts/K + 90% interval) directly adjacent to metrics.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce globally and keep 10 Hz telemetry updates isolated behind useSyncExternalStore hooks (useSocketStats, useJunctionLive, useRecentFrames).
Do disable and explain role-restricted actions client-side using useAuth() zone/role checks matching backend JWT enforcement.
donts: Don't invent literal numbers, fake accuracy percentages, or synthetic placeholder nodes anywhere in JSX.
Don't use frosted glassmorphism, neon glow shadows, animated pulse rings on idle UI, or multi-stop gradient card backgrounds.
Don't omit min-w-0 on grid/flex children wrapping <select> elements, tables, or long trace IDs at mobile widths.
Don't suppress focus indicators (outline: none / focus:outline-none) without restoring a compliant visible ring.
